title: A crew command that failed, run with --json

notes.description: Only from the commands of result.json: the lines the command printed before it failed, without the `tares factory: ` prefix. What had already happened. For a person, not for parsing. Absent when nothing was printed.

left_to_watch.description: `crew update` only, and only when it left stations out and another station failed: the same list as in result.json, so a caller still sees which stations were skipped.

code.description: A stable name for the failure. Callers branch on this, never on the message.

message.description: The line the text mode prints, without the `tares factory: ` prefix.
